desc:
[ ALPHA RELEASE 0.6]

New Mode
 - Solo Survivor Mode
  - Max Wave Endless
  - Damage 100%
  - Health 100%
  - Single-player mode only

New Accessory
- Solo Aura
- Black Coat

New Weapon
- Twin Dagger
  - Twin Cleave
  - Arise, Igris
  - Twin Soldier, Arise
  - Ruler's Authority

- Soul Reaper Blade
  - Heaven Piercer
  - Overhead Slash
  - Sword Embedment
  - Blade's Edge

Bug Fix
 - Fixed accessory stat calculation issues.
 - Gameplay balance adjustments.

CONTROLS: 
Weapon Ability 1 - Z / LB
Weapon Ability 2 - X / LT
Weapon Ability 3 - C / RT
Weapon Ability 4 - V / RB
Ultimate - G / DPad Up
Dash - Q / Button Y 
M1 Attack - LMB / Button B 
Block - F / Button X

Tags: Co-op, PVE, Fighting, Survival, Zombie,  Anime
